@title TriggerAgreement
 @notice A pre-arranged relief payout whose trigger rule is fixed before the season starts.
 Three parties must approve the same spec hash: the funder (who also deposits the
 money), a representative of the people the money is for, and an independent checker.
 Once all three have approved, nothing about the agreement can be changed; a different
 rule needs a new agreement. After the observation window closes, independent data
 providers commit and then reveal their verdicts. The money moves only when a
 pre-agreed quorum of providers agrees; otherwise the agreement enters a dispute that
 ends either by unanimous decision of the three parties or, after a deadline, by the
 fallback outcome they chose up front. No single party can decide the result.
 The spec itself (index, base period, data sources, gap-filling rule, threshold) lives
 off-chain as canonical JSON; only its sha256 is stored here.
